# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2034 refined_field_assignment"
description: "A field assignment changes a field of a var whose type, or the type of a prefix of the path, is a refined type (design §17.135)."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2034` prints this explanation offline.

A field assignment changes a field of a `var` whose type, or the type of a prefix of the path,
is a refined type (design §17.135). `x.n = v` on `var x` is sugar for
`x = PosRepr { ..x, n: v }` (§8.1), and a record update yields the base type, so the statement
would put an unchecked `PosRepr` where a `Pos` is promised and skip the predicate. The rule
holds in every module, the declaring one included. Rebuild the value through the refinement:
`Pos.from(…)` for a value the program trusts (it is checked, and `sakura audit` lists the site)
or `Pos.validate(…)?` for data. Whole reassignment (`x = next(x)`) and a field assignment on a
plain record whose field is refined (`r.total = Decimal.add(r.total, y)`) are unaffected.

Wrong:

```sakura
type Pos = PosRepr where it.n > 0
var x = p
x.n = -1
```

Fixed:

```sakura
x = Pos.from(PosRepr { ..x, n: -1 })
x = Pos.validate(PosRepr { ..x, n: input })?
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2034_refined_field_assignment.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V2034_refined_field_assignment.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
// `x.n = -1` is sugar for `x = PosRepr { ..x, n: -1 }`, a `PosRepr`, so it would hand back a
// `Pos` whose predicate never ran. Rebuild through `Pos.from` or `Pos.validate` instead.
type PosRepr = { n: Int }

type Pos = PosRepr where it.n > 0

fn f(p: Pos) -> Pos {
  var x = p
  x.n = -1
  x
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2034_refined_field_assignment.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V2034_refined_field_assignment.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
type PosRepr = { n: Int }

type Pos = PosRepr where it.n > 0

fn f(p: Pos) -> Pos {
  var x = p
  x = Pos.from(PosRepr { ..x, n: 1 })
  x
}
```
